import numpy as np

def softmax(x):
    e_x = np.exp(x - np.max(x))
    return e_x / np.sum(e_x)

def generate(model_forward, prompt_ids, max_length,
             temperature=1.0, top_k=50):
    generated = prompt_ids.copy()
    vocab_size = model_forward(generated).shape[-1]
    while len(generated) < max_length:
        logits = model_forward(generated)[-1]
        logits = logits / temperature
        indices = np.argsort(logits)[-top_k:]
        filtered = np.full_like(logits, -1e9)
        filtered[indices] = logits[indices]
        probs = softmax(filtered)
        next_token = np.random.choice(vocab_size, p=probs)
        generated = np.append(generated, next_token)
    return generated
